title: UI pass: give every vendor's UI role write access to the renders directory, so S660's render commands work for codex, grok and claude-local

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S660 (landed 2026-11-28) points the UI brief's CLI and TUI render commands straight at the renders directory (adj 667), but only the cloud claude UI pass is granted write access there (internal/daemon/runner.go:44, S369), and S648 gates the "renders directory is an exception" sentence on in.Vendor == "claude" (adj 671). A codex, grok or claude-local UI pass is therefore told to write files it cannot write (S648 finding 1).

Owner decision, 2026-11-28 (key ui.renders-dir-grant-vendors): grant each vendor's UI pass write access to the renders directory, like claude's grant, and then show the renders-directory sentence to every vendor again. Jon chose 'Grant renders/ to every UI vendor'.
